title: LUCA: A Synthetic World for Experimental Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.03100v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: [Note, November 2026: the experimental results in this version are affected by implementation issues in the simulation environment and should not be relied upon pending correction. See the author note on page 1.]   An experimental agent can succeed for the wrong reasons. Evaluations, however, often focus on the outcome, not the experiments, evidence, and inferences that produced it. We introduce LUCA, a configurable synthetic world for evaluating this process under fully known ground truth. Agents learn unknown regulatory systems through budgeted experimentation, then predict unseen interventions, diagnose hidden faults, and attempt rescues. This setup allows us to evaluate experiment selection, prediction, diagnosis, and intervention separately.   Across seven frontier LLMs and three baselines, these capabilities dissociate sharply. Agents frequently rescue malfunctioning systems while diagnosing the wrong fault; diagnosis varies 7x

translated_title: LUCA：一个用于实验推理的合成世界
translated_abstract: [注，2026年11月：本版本中的实验结果受到模拟环境中实现问题的影响，在修正之前不应依赖这些结果，请参阅第1页的作者说明。] 一个实验智能体可能因错误的原因而取得成功。然而，现有的评估往往只关注最终结果，而非产生该结果的实验、证据和推理过程。我们提出了LUCA，一个可配置的合成世界，用于在完全已知真值的条件下评估这一过程。智能体通过有预算限制的实验来学习未知的调控系统，然后预测未见过的干预、诊断隐藏的故障并尝试实施拯救。这一设置使我们能够分别评估实验选择、预测、诊断和干预这几种能力。在七个前沿大语言模型和三个基线方法的测试中，这些能力表现出显著的分离：智能体经常在诊断出错误故障的情况下仍能成功拯救故障系统；诊断能力之间相差7倍（原文在此处截止）。
tldr: 该论文提出LUCA——一个在完全已知真值下评估智能体实验推理过程的可配置合成世界基准，通过让智能体在有预算约束下学习未知调控系统并分别考察实验选择、预测、诊断和干预能力，发现前沿大语言模型在这些能力上显著分离，常常在误诊故障的情况下仍能成功拯救系统。
en_tdlr: LUCA is a configurable synthetic-world benchmark for evaluating experimental reasoning under fully known ground truth, revealing that frontier LLMs' experiment selection, prediction, diagnosis, and intervention capabilities sharply dissociate—agents often rescue malfunctioning systems while diagnosing the wrong fault.
